subject: LACS
title: Latin American and Caribbean Studies Reading Course
description: Supervised reading in advance special topics in Latin American and Caribbean Studies under the direction of member of faculty.

prerequisites.text: Having completed at least two of the required courses of the Program.

subject: LACS
title: Research Seminar: Latin America and the Caribbean
description: An interdisciplinary research seminar on topics of common interest to staff and students of the Latin-American and Caribbean Studies Program.

restrictions.text: Open to Program students and to others with permission of the Program Adviser.

subject: LACS
title: Honours Thesis
description: This course is designed to allow students to pursue interdisciplinary research projects under close supervision.

prerequisites.text: LACS 497 and permission of the Program Adviser

restrictions.text: This course is only available to Latin American and Caribbean Studies Honours program students.

subject: LACS
title: Internship: Latin America and Caribbean Studies
description: Internship with an approved host institution or organization.

prerequisites.text: Permission of the program Internship Advisor.

restrictions.text: Open to U2 and U3 students after completing 30 credits of a 90 credit degree program or 45 credits of a 69-120 credit program, a minimum CGPA of 2.7 and permission of the program Internship Advisor. This course will normally not fulfill program requirements for seminar or 400 level courses.
